sota_features.name: Hybrid Search (Dense + Sparse)
sota_features.notes: Uses RRF fusion with configurable dense/sparse ratios (40/60 default favors BM25)

sota_features.name: Multi-Query Retrieval
sota_features.notes: LLM-based query expansion generates 2-3 semantically varied queries

sota_features.name: Reranking (Cross-Encoder)
sota_features.notes: Supports Cohere rerank-english-v3.0 and BGE-reranker-v2-m3

sota_features.name: Parent-Child Chunking
sota_features.notes: Separate collections for parents (sections) and children (chunks)

sota_features.name: Neighbor Context Expansion
sota_features.notes: Configurable window (±1 chunks by default)

sota_features.name: Metadata Filtering
sota_features.notes: Indexed fields: report_id, year, tier, state, finding_type, severity, section_type

sota_features.name: Auto-Filter Extraction
sota_features.notes: Detects states, years, tiers from query text

sota_features.name: Context-Augmented Embeddings
sota_features.notes: Prefixes chunks with report title and parent TOC entry

sota_features.name: Response Style Adaptation
sota_features.notes: Styles: concise, detailed, executive, technical, comparative, explanatory

sota_features.name: Streaming Responses (SSE)
sota_features.notes: Supports OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini streaming

sota_features.name: Grounded Citations
sota_features.notes: Citations format: [Section, p.XX] with click-to-navigate in frontend

sota_features.name: Groundedness Verification
sota_features.notes: Uses lightweight LLM to verify each factual claim against cited sources

sota_features.name: Context Sufficiency Check
sota_features.notes: Emits 'low_relevance' caveat when top rerank score < threshold

sota_features.name: Query Decomposition
sota_features.notes: LLM detects simple vs multi-hop complexity

sota_features.name: Iterative Retrieval
sota_features.notes: Max 3 iterations per sub-query with reformulation

sota_features.name: Multi-Hop Reasoning
sota_features.notes: Merges retrievals from sub-queries for synthesis

sota_features.name: Execution Bounds
sota_features.notes: max_sub_queries=4, max_iterations=10, max_wall_ms=20000

sota_features.name: Query Routing
sota_features.notes: Could route to entity graph, temporal retriever, or standard RAG

sota_features.name: RAPTOR / Hierarchical Retrieval
sota_features.notes: Would require summary pyramid during indexing

sota_features.name: Self-RAG / Adaptive Retrieval
sota_features.notes: Current system always retrieves

sota_features.name: Corrective RAG
sota_features.notes: Groundedness verification is post-hoc, not corrective

sota_features.name: Knowledge Graph Integration
sota_features.notes: Entity graph with canonicalization (requires Postgres)
